ladder.name: The Live Grid
ladder.adds: energy only: the DAM and real time at a real battery's own node, with ERCOT notices, NWS alerts and the battery's outages at their real minutes
ladder.does: bids the DAM, offers real-time curves and files its COP, waking at milestones, notices and its own reminders

ladder.name: Sun, Storage and Reserves
ladder.adds: ERCOT's five ancillary services in the DAM and real time, with state-of-charge duration rules, deployments and capacity-short charges; a co-located solar option (modelled)
ladder.does: co-optimises energy and reserves and keeps the charge to back them

ladder.name: Weather Front
ladder.adds: three operating days across a weather front, on ERCOT's forecasts as each was issued
ladder.does: bids three day-ahead markets as the forecasts move

ladder.name: The Market Floor
ladder.adds: price impact: its DAM offers re-clear the day-ahead market against the day's real offers, disclosed 60 days later
ladder.does: offers into a market its own bids move

v2.alt: GPT-6.1 Sol at the desk of Battery S02 (Houston, 100 MW / 206 MWh) on 23 August 2026: the node's prices as they post, the battery's state of charge and dispatch, and each wake-up's tool calls with their results, then the settled grade
v2.caption: GridSimEnv Desk, v2, The Live Grid: GPT-6.1 Sol trades Battery S02 (Houston, 100 MW / 206 MWh), a real ERCOT battery, on 23 August 2026, beside its 125 tool calls. It bids the day-ahead market at 09:30 the day before, sends 10 sets of real-time curves and wakes 35 times, 13 for ERCOT notices, NWS alerts or outages and 15 for its own reminders. The battery settles at ⁠$48,662, hindsight capture C 0.347; the real operator's own bids, replayed, earn ⁠$34,022. [Open the desk page](https://earakely-scale-gridsimenv-agentenv.static.hf.space/desk.html?v=v2). Data: ERCOT and NWS, public; not affiliated with or endorsed by ERCOT.
